newsitem.title: DUBAI: United Arab Emirates plans $817 mln housing fund.
newsitem.headline: United Arab Emirates plans $817 mln housing fund.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) plans to set up a three billion dirham ($817 million) fund to provide interest-free housing loans to its nationals, al-Eqtisadi business weekly reported.
It said the UAE government will provide the fund with 300 million dirhams a year for the next 10 years, after which it will be self-financing.
"The fund, proposed by the ministry of public works will provide eligible UAE nationals with interest-free housing loans up to 500,000 dirhams," al-Eqtisadi said in its latest issue.
"A service charge of two percent will be added to the total value of the loan to cover administrative expenses," the weekly added.
Currently most UAE nationals take bank loans to finance construction on land allotted to them free by the government.
Al-Eqtisadi said the government would continue allotting land free to its nationals.
